blocks.text: A petition calling for celebrities convicted of drunk driving to be barred from appearing on television has been submitted to the National Assembly’s online petition platform, following actor Ko Kyung-pyo’s highly publicized drunk driving accident. The petitioner requested that celebrities penalized for drunk driving face temporary or permanent suspensions from appearing on all broadcast platforms. READ: ‘Reply 1988’ actor Ko Kyung-pyo caught drunk driving after truck crash The petition further proposed extending restrictions to individuals who only receive fines, broadening existing broadcast appearance bans.
